'''Stanislav Brebera''' (10 August 1925 – 11 May 2012) was a [[Czech Republic|Czech]] [[chemist]].
He was born in [[Přelouč]] and died in [[Pardubice]].<ref>{{cite news|url=http://www.denik.cz/pardubicky-kraj/zemrel-vynalezce-trhaviny-semtex-20120518-rrb0.html|title=Zemřel vynálezce trhaviny Semtex|last=Dubský|first=Kamil |date=18 May 2012|publisher=[[Deník]]|language=cs|access-date=18 May 2012}}</ref>

Brebera spent his career in [[Czechoslovakia|Czechoslovak]] state-hold ''Research Institute for Chemical Industry'', currently [[Explosia]] in [[Pardubice]]. He is best known for the developing the [[plastic explosive]] known as [[Semtex]] in the late 1950s, which was put on the market in 1964.<ref>{{cite web | title=Semtex | url=http://www.radio.cz/en/static/inventors/semtex|publisher=[[Czech Radio]]| access-date=14 December 2013}}</ref>
